title: Nixer N10 Mixer Kit Nic Salt - 10mg
description: The Nixer Salt Mixer Kit N10 allows you to create 60ml of 10mg nicotine salt e-liquid with a balanced VG/PG ratio of 50VG/50PG. This kit is perfect for vapers who prefer a smoother throat hit and quick nicotine delivery, ideal for use with pod vape kits. Each kit contains everything you need to mix with your Nixer Longfill Flavour concentrates, including nic shots. Simply combine the contents of the Mixer Kit with your chosen Nixer Longfill concentrate to create a customised e-liquid tailored to your vaping Nixer Mixer Kits are designed to provide a versatile and convenient solution for vapers who want to customise their e-liquids. Made in the UK by Dispergo, these kits ensure a premium vaping experience with your preferred nicotine strength and VG/PG ratio. How to use the Nixer Mixer Kit: 1 . Open your Nixer Longfill e-liquid concentrate bottle and pull out the nib. 2 . Pour in all 3 bottles contained in your chosen Nixer Mixer Kit. 3 . Reattach the nib back on the longfill bottle and put the lid on. 4 . Shake the bottle vigorously for 1 minute. 5 . Your e-liquid is ready.
